correctness.rationale: Proof enumerates all greedy phrase-boundary possibilities by comparing c to a and 2a, covers first-occurrence literals and exact equality boundaries; reversing uses complement symmetry. The extreme-gap criteria follow from independent sharp interval bounds -1<=A<=2, -2<=B<=1, and the limit law follows from independent uniform normalized disjoint run pairs. Direct longest-previous-factor test passed 28561 parameter quadruples in both directions; separate composition census passed lengths 4..30 and the rational convolution. Computations are corroboration, not a substitute for the proof.
